apps.localizedDescription: 让 Agent 读取和操作真实 iPhone 的 Runner，由 SideStore 安装和续签。需要开发者模式及一台配置了 iPhoneUse 和 Xcode 的 Mac；完成配对后可通过同一网络无线使用。由 Agent 按任务需要启动，点开手机图标不会自行开始控制。0.17.19 build 3 已实测安装、续签及无线读屏；后续上游版本会自动构建并校验，再进入此订阅源，但仍需单独确认设备兼容性。这是社区兼容包，并非上游官方发行包。

versions.localizedDescription:
Experimental SideStore compatibility package of iphone-use 0.17.19 (upstream commit 47cf89852a1de8f2a6670ef4ae811708621825f4).

Build 3 relocates XCTest to Frameworks/iPhoneUse.xctest for SideStore 0.7 compatibility. The runner implementation is unchanged. Personal provisioning profiles and certificate signatures are removed; the upstream license and required notice are included.

The published IPA has now been installed through SideStore 0.7, appeared in My Apps, and refreshed individually (20% progress then 7 DAYS, no alert). The installed Runner launched using Xcode UseDestinationArtifacts. Direct iPhoneUse screenshot reads and UI operations succeeded over USB and encrypted CoreDevice Wi-Fi after unplugging USB. SideStore and PiliPlus BTR were preserved.

SideStore manages signing and refresh. The configured Mac/Xcode launcher starts the preinstalled Runner only when an Agent requests a session; login and status queries do not start phone control. Opening the phone icon alone does not start the XCTest session. This remains a community compatibility package rather than an official upstream release. Future CI-built versions require separate device validation.

Published IPA: 10,484,780 bytes
